messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The ledger service has a deploy freeze from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 because of the fiscal year close. [constraint; valid 2026-03-11 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-03-11]
- As of 2025-08-19, deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC; the old Tuesday 13:00-15:00 UTC window is retired. [constraint; valid 2025-08-19 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-08-19]
    earlier: Deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-02-06 to 2025-08-19; recorded by standup/ember/2025-02-06]
- As of 2025-10-13, the ledger service is owned by the Cinder team. [valid 2025-10-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-13-ledger]
    earlier: The ledger service is owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-10-13; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- On 2026-05-28, the Ember team noticed that the ledger service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-28 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-28]
- The ledger service depends on the auth gateway for service tokens. [valid 2025-03-04 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-04]
- The billing API depends on the ledger service for invoice postings. [valid 2025-01-09 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-09-2]
- Lena is the release captain for Q1 2026. [decision; valid 2025-05-22 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-05-22]
- Until 2025-09-23, the reporting service depended on the ledger service for the nightly balance export; it no longer depends on the ledger service. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-23]
    earlier: The reporting service depends on the ledger service for the nightly balance export. [valid 2025-01-21 to 2025-09-23; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-21]
- The ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change. [valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-21-2]
- From 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings the Cinder team instead of the Atlas team. [valid 2025-10-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-13-ledger]
- The notifier relies on the bus for delivery events, so the notifier is down whenever the bus is down. [valid 2025-02-11 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-11]
- feature-flags' p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2025-04-24 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-24-2]
- As of 2026-02-03, the Atlas team does a no-deploy Friday. [decision; valid 2026-02-03 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-02-03]
- Farah is the release captain for Q3 2025, per the 2026-04-14 team Dune standup. [valid 2026-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-14-3]
- The webhook dispatcher relies on the bus for outbound events, so the webhook dispatcher is down whenever the bus is down. [valid 2025-02-11 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-11-2]
- As of 2025-07-30, Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team and Tomasz is no longer the primary on-call. [decision; valid 2025-07-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-30]
    earlier: As of 2025-06-19, Tomasz is the primary on-call for the Atlas team and Priya Raman is no longer the primary on-call. [decision; valid 2025-06-19 to 2025-07-30; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-06-19]
    earlier: As of 2025-05-13, Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team and Tomasz is no longer the primary on-call. [decision; valid 2025-05-13 to 2025-06-19; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-05-13]
    earlier: Priya Raman is no longer the primary on-call for the Atlas team; Tomasz is the primary on-call for the Atlas team this cycle as of 2025-04-03. [decision; valid 2025-04-03 to 2025-05-13; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-04-03]
    earlier: Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team starting 2025-02-12; Tomasz is off rotation. [decision; valid 2025-02-12 to 2025-04-03; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-02-12]
    earlier: Tomasz takes the first on-call rotation for the Atlas team. [decision; valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-02-12; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-09]
- The billing API has a deploy freeze from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02, covering the peak season. [constraint; valid 2025-11-11 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-11-11]

Question: What is the current deploy window for the ledger?

message.reasoning:
The question asks about the current deploy window for the ledger. Looking through the memory:

- The ledger service has a deploy freeze from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 because of the fiscal year close. That's a freeze, not a deploy window.
- The job scheduler deploy windows are mentioned (Tuesdays and Fridays 09:00-10:30 UTC), but that's for the job scheduler, not the ledger.

There's no deploy window specified for the ledger service. The only ledger-related deploy constraint is the freeze. So the answer is "I don't know".
